definition: Express connects easily to SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) using ORMs like Sequelize or Prisma. These tools map your JavaScript objects directly to relational database tables.

answers.question: When should you avoid using SQL Database Integration?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
